# Selección de registros sísmicos {#sec-srs}

{{< include /_chapters/srs.model.es.md >}}

## Registros Seleccionados {#sec-srs_results}

### Conjunto seleccionado {#sec-srs_results_records}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (!is.null(SelectionTable)) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(SelectionTable))) {
    .knitSelectionBlock(
      path = "/_tbl/SRS.qmd",
      vars = list(CAP = readCaption("tbl.SRS.ES")),
      stem = "srs-records",
      selections = SelectionTable,
      i = i,
      root = root,
      heading = SelectionTable$label[[i]],
      level = 4L,
      anchor = "sec-srs_records",
      context = "capítulo SRS"
    )
  }
  rm(i)
}
```

### Compatibilidad con el espectro objetivo {#sec-srs_results_psa}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (!is.null(SelectionTable)) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(SelectionTable))) {
    SRS_SITE_TEXT <- .reportLabel(envir = list2env(
      .reportSelection(SelectionTable, i, "srs-psa")$vars,
      parent = knitr::knit_global()
    ))
    if (!nzchar(SRS_SITE_TEXT) && !is.null(params$site) && length(params$site)) {
      SRS_SITE_TEXT <- trimws(as.character(params$site[[1L]]))
    }
    if (!nzchar(SRS_SITE_TEXT) && !is.null(params$location) && length(params$location)) {
      SRS_SITE_TEXT <- trimws(as.character(params$location[[1L]]))
    }
    if (!nzchar(SRS_SITE_TEXT)) SRS_SITE_TEXT <- "el proyecto"
    CAPTION <- sprintf(
      readCaption("fig.srs.psa.ES"),
      SRS_SITE_TEXT
    )
    .knitSelectionBlock(
      path = "/_fig/srs.psa.qmd",
      vars = list(CAPTION = CAPTION),
      stem = "srs-psa",
      selections = SelectionTable,
      i = i,
      root = root,
      heading = SelectionTable$label[[i]],
      level = 4L,
      anchor = "sec-srs_psa",
      context = "capítulo SRS"
    )
    rm(CAPTION, SRS_SITE_TEXT)
  }
  rm(i)
}
rm(list = intersect(c("SiteTable", "SelectionTable"), ls()))
```
